text: THIS POLICY IS WRITTEN ON A CLAIMS MADE AND REPORTED BASIS AND COVERS ONLY CLAIMS FIRST MADE AGAINST THE INSUREDS DURING THE POLICY PERIOD OR THE EXTENDED REPORTING PERIOD, IF APPLICABLE, AND REPORTED IN WRITING TO THE INSURER PURSUANT TO THE TERMS HEREIN. text: F. Discrimination means the violation of any Federal, State, or local statute, regulation, ordinance or common law concerning discrimination in employment anywhere in the worid.

text: L. Loss does not include: 1. any amounts for which the Insureds are legally or financially absolved from payment; or 2. taxes or the loss of tax benefits, or fines or penalties imposed by law: or 3. the muitiple portion of any multiplied damage award: 4. the future salary, wages, commissions, or Benefits of a claimant who has been or shall be hired, promoted, or reinstated to employment pursuant to a settlement of. order in, or other resolution of any Claim; 5. any payment, incentive, or other compensation that is granted in the form of securities of the Policyholder or is based on the value of securities of the Policyholder: 6. any Salary, wages, commissions, Benefits or other monetary payments which constitute severance payments or payments pursuant to a notice period: 7. any amount incurred by an Insured in the defense or investigation of any action, proceeding, or demand that is not then a Claim even if (i) such amount also benefits the defense of a covered Claim. or (ii) such action, proceeding or demand subsequently gives rise toa Claim: . 8 matters uninsurable under the law applicable to this Policy: or 3. text: T. text: A. name: V.A. Limit of Liability
text: A. Limit of Liability Tha Insurer's maximum aggregate liability under ail Insuring Agreements for all Loss arising from all Claims first made dunng the Policy Period shall be the Limit of Liability set forth in {tem 3 in the Daciarations. The Limit of Liability for the Extended Reporting Period, if exercised, shall be part of and not in addition to the Limit of Liability for the immediately preceding Policy Period. The purchase of the extended Reporting Period shall not increase or reinstate the Limit of Liability, which shall be the maximum lability of the Insurer for such Policy Period and Extended Reporting Period, combined. Defense Costs are part of, and not in addition to, the Limit of Liability set forth in Item 3 in the Declarations and the payment by the insurer of Defense Costs reduces and may totally exhaust such Limit of Liability. : if the Lirnit of Liability is exhausted by payment of Loss, the Insurer's obligations under this Policy shall be completely fulfilled and extinguished. All Claims arising from the same Wrongful Act and/or all interrelated Wrongful Acts shall be deemed one Claim, and such Claim shail be deemed to be first made on the earlier date that: (i) any of the Claims is first made against an Insured under this Policy or any prior policy, or (i/) valid notice was given by the Insureds under this Policy or any prior policy of any Wrongful Act. or any fact, circumstance, situation, event, transaction or cause which underlies such Claim. Coverage under this Policy shail apply only with respect to Claims deemed to have been first made during the Policy Period and reported in writing to the Insurer in accordance with the terms herein.

name: V.B. Retentions
text: B. Retentions The Insurer shall be liable for only that part of Loss arising from a Claim which is excess of the Retention set forth in Item 4 in the Declarations, and such Retention shall be borne by the Insureds. uninsured and at their own risk.

name: V.C. Defense and Settlement
text: C. Defense and Settlement The Insurer shall have both the right and the duty to defend, and appoint counsel with respect to, any Claim made against the Insureds alleging a Wrongful Act, even if such Claim is groundless, false or fraudulent. The insureds shall have the right, at their own expense. to associate with the Insurer in the defense of any Claim, including but nat limited to negotiating a settlement. However, the Insurer shall not be obligated to defend any Claim after the Limit of Liability set forth at Itern 3 in the Ceclarations has been exhausted or after the rejection of a settlement offer as described below, The Insureds shall not settle any Claim, incur any Defense Costs, admit or assume any liability, stipulate to any judgment, or otherwise assume any contractual obligation, without the Insurer's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. The Insurer shall not be liable for any settlement, Defense Costs, assumed obligation, admission or stipulated judgment to which it has not consented or for which the Insureds are not legally obligated. The Insureds will provide the insurer with all information, assistance and cooperation that the Insurer reasonably requests. The insureds shall not knowingly take any action which increases the Insurer's exposure for Loss under this Policy. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the insurer's consent shall not be required with respect to any Claim if the total Loss (inclusive of Defense Costs) arising from such Claim is less than fifty (50) percent of the applicable Retention set forth in Item 4 in the Declarations. EP 0001 (Ed. 1005) Page 9 of 13 Printed in U.S.A. if the Insurer recommends a settlement within the Policy's applicable Limit of Liability which is acceptable to the claimant and the Insureds unreasonably refuse to consent, then the insurer's liability for all Loss on account of such Claim shalt not exceed the amount for which the Insurer coutd have settled such Claim, plus an additional fifty (50) percent of such amount, plus Defense Costs up to the date the Insureds refused to settle such Claim. However, in no event shail the Insurer's liability exceed the applicable Limit of Liability set forth in Item 3 in the Declarations.

text: A. if during the Policy Period any Insured becomes aware cf a Potential Claim, and the Insured gives written notice of such Potential Claim to the insurer during the Policy Period, then any Claim subsequently arising from such Potential Claim shall be considered to have been. made during the Policy Period in which tne Potential Claim was first reported to the Insurer. text: C. Written notice of any such subsequent Claim resulting from a Potential Claim must be given to the Insurer as soon as practicable, but in no event later than sixty (60) days after such Claim is first made.

name: VIII.C. Cancellation/Nonrenewal
text: Cancallation/Nonrenewal 1. name: VIII.D. Other Insurance
text: Other Insurance If any Loss arising from any Third Party Claim, is insured by any other policy(ies) of insurance, prior of current, then this Policy shall apply only in excess of and will hot contribute with the amount of any deductibles, retentions and limits of liability under such other policy(ies) whether such policy(ies) is Stated to be primary, contributory, excess, contingent or otherwise, unless such policy(ies) is written to be specifically excess of this Policy by reference in such other policy(ies) to this Policy's Policy Number indicated in the Declarations. in all other events, this Policy is intended to provide primary insurance.

text: Valuation and Currency | All premiums, limits, Retentions, Loss, and other amounts under this Policy are expressed and payable in the currency of the United States. if judgment is rendered, settiement is denominated or another element of Loss under this Policy is stated in a currency other than United States dollars, payment under this Policy shail be made in United States collars at the rate of exchange published in The Wall Street Journal on the date the judgment becomes final or payment of the settlement or other element of Loss is due.

text: Subrogation In the event of any payment under this Policy, the Insurer shall be subrogated to the extent of such payment to all the insureds’ rights of recovery, and the Insureds shail execute all papers required and shail do everything necessary to secure and preserve such rights, including the execution of such documents necessary to enable the Insurer etfectively to bring suit in the name of the Insureds.

text: No Action Against Insurer No action shall lie against the Insurer unless, as a condition precedent thereto, thera has been full compliance with all the terms of this Policy. text: Authonzation Clause By acceptance of this Policy, the Parent Company agrees to act on behalf of the insureds with respect to the giving and receiving of any notice provided for in this Policy (except the giving of notice to apply for any Extended Reporting Period), the payment of premiums and the receipt of any retum premiums that may become due under this Policy, and the agreement to and acceptance of endorsements, and the Insureds agree that the Parent Company shail act on their behalf.

text: Alteration and Assignment No change in, modification of, or assignment of interest under this Policy shall be effective except when made by a written endorsement to this Policy which is signed by an authorized representative of the insurer.
